definition.text: Of iron. (1.) A Meholathite, the father of Adriel (2 Sam. 21:8). (2.) A Gileadite of Rogelim who was distinguished for his loyalty to David. He liberally provided for the king’s followers (2 Sam. 17:27). David on his death-bed, remembering his kindness, commended Barzillai’s children to the care of Solomon (1 Kings 2:7). (3.) A priest who married a daughter of the preceding (Ezra 2:61).

lemmas.gloss: Barzillai, the name of three Israelites
a Giladite or descendant of Gilad
Rogelim, a place East of the Jordan
Kots, the name of two Israelites
